libsamplerate-js's default AudioWorklet source, from @elevenlabs/client's addLibsamplerateModule(). PROVEN NOT LIVE by full reachability trace (WI-7116, not a bundle grep — that is precisely what D-004 forbids treating as a verdict): addLibsamplerateModule is only ever called from the SDK's setupInputOutput(), which short-circuits to the LiveKit-native connection.input/output for a WebRTCConnection and only constructs the MediaDeviceInput/Output (the sole callers of addLibsamplerateModule) for a WebSocketConnection. Both of our two live Conversation.startSession() call sites (packages/operator-core/lib/voice-engines/elevenlabs-conv.ts, apps/operator/app/el-min/page.tsx) hardcode connectionType:'webrtc' — no runtime fallback exists between the two connection types once resolved, so the fetch cannot fire under any input. Guarded going forward by apps/operator/app/_components/elevenlabs-libsamplerate-cdn.test.ts (asserts every live call site stays pinned, and pins the SDK's own dispatch shape so a future @elevenlabs/client bump that changes it fails loudly here). No fix applied: mirroring the worklet to wire a libsampleratePath override would be dead-code busywork for an unreachable path — if a future call site legitimately needs connectionType:'websocket', wire libsampleratePath/workletPaths (AudioWorkletConfig) at the same time; the guard test will fail first and point here.

ajv's $id for its data-reference meta-schema. A JSON-Schema $id is an IDENTIFIER used as a registry key, never dereferenced — ajv resolves it against its own bundled copy. The trailing '#' is the empty JSON-pointer fragment, which is the giveaway that this is a schema id rather than a download URL.
